description: A picture of a scene as the editor's 2D or 3D view draws it, including what its @tool scripts draw, which runtime_capture cannot show. Needs a connected editor that draws: a visible one, or a hidden one on Windows.

height.description: Scale to this height. Width follows unless given.

inline.description: Send the picture back in the answer. Default true, as a JPEG when smaller than the PNG and nothing is transparent. false needs outputPath.

outputPath.description: Also save a PNG here. Absolute path outside the project, to a file that does not exist.

view.description: Which of the editor's views draws the scene. Default 3d for a Node3D root, else 2d.

width.description: Scale to this width. Height follows unless given.

name: editor_capture
title: Capture the editor's view of a scene
